item.title: Enhancing fairness in climate action through policy packages
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 13 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02751-5

Achieving climate neutrality requires policies perceived as fair, with equity both between and within income groups. Here researchers evaluate the equity implications of different European Union climate policy packages and show how a mixed policy design can balance trade-offs between two equity dimensions.
